coverageHint.cargo: Accepts coverage.json or lcov.info. Install cargo-llvm-cov first (cargo install cargo-llvm-cov), then run cargo llvm-cov --json --output-path target/llvm-cov/coverage.json
coverageHint.gotest: Accepts cobertura or lcov.info: run go test -coverprofile=coverage.out, then gocover-cobertura to produce coverage.xml
coverageHint.jest: Accepts coverage-summary.json or lcov.info — run npm test -- --coverage
coverageHint.maven: Accepts jacoco.xml. Without the pom plugin use mvn -B test org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin:0.8.11:prepare-agent org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin:0.8.11:report, which writes target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml
coverageHint.other: Accepts lcov.info / jacoco.xml / cobertura.xml / istanbul JSON — generate one of them first
coverageHint.playwright: Accepts coverage-summary.json or lcov.info; needs nyc/monocart to emit coverage
coverageHint.vitest: Accepts coverage-summary.json or lcov.info — run npx vitest run --coverage
coverageHint.mocha: Accepts coverage-summary.json or lcov.info; needs nyc/c8 to emit coverage

cr.title: Change Regression Report
cr.open: Build a regression report from the code changes
cr.intro: Pick a baseline and generate: the static pass shows which modules and layers changed, which edits have no matching test and which high-risk areas are touched; the model then fills in the feature points and regression scenarios.
cr.empty: No code changes found for this baseline.
cr.ignoredHint: IDE settings and build output (.idea, target, node_modules, …) are kept out of the report
cr.truncated: The patch was longer than 200KB and is truncated, so API changes may be incomplete.
cr.aiHint: Fills in affected features, must-test scenarios, regression scope, risks and an acceptance checklist; needs a default model in Model settings.
cr.aiUnavailable: The report was not stored, so the AI step is unavailable; the static report and export still work.
